purpose: Controlled SEH model comparison using reference-generated versus SARscope-generated fields, not exact historical protocol emulation

settings.preprocessing: SARscope existing field filter, fitted only to each training fold; no combined train/test scaling

expected_scope: Block scaling should remove constant relative field scales; a whole-block sign flip should not change PLS predictions
Raw fields are a negative control because relative weighting differs
Finite absolute variance floors may retain different columns across raw unit conventions; report rather than hide this
No fitting setting is selected by external scores or closeness to the paper's q2
This does not emulate the external CLI's internal 16/5 split or train/test-combined preprocessing
This does not validate hydrogen-bond fields, CoMFA, geometry preparation, generalisation or a new target family
